attributes.__structure__:
ATTRS:
  VERSION: 0.0.0
COORDS:
  date_time:
    name: date_time
    coords:
    - date_time
    unit:
      tick: m
      tz: UTC
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    type: datetime64[m]
    na_value: null
    description: Time coordinate
    df_col: date_time
    source_unit:
      tick: m
      tz: CET
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    range: null
    composed:
    - date_time
    chunk_size: 1024
    step_limits:
    - 1
    - 1
    - hour
    sorted: true
  site_id:
    name: site_id
    coords:
    - site_id
    unit: null
    type: int32
    na_value: 0
    description: Estimated location ID according to the table of possible locations.
      Including the lab.
    df_col: site_id
    source_unit: null
    range: null
    composed:
    - site_id
    chunk_size: 1
    step_limits: any_new
    sorted: []
  calibration:
    name: calibration
    coords:
    - calibration
    unit:
      tick: m
      tz: UTC
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    type: str[16]
    na_value: "\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\
      \uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF\uFFFF"
    description: Date of calibration indexing the simulation parameters.
    df_col: calibration
    source_unit:
      tick: m
      tz: UTC
      dayfirst: false
      yearfirst: true
    range: null
    composed:
    - calibration
    chunk_size: 1
    step_limits: any_new
    sorted: true
VARS:
  velocity:
    name: velocity
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    - calibration
    unit: meter / second
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Infiltration, Darcy velocity of water on the surface and deep model
      interface.
    df_col: velocity
    source_unit: meter / second
    range: null
  pressure_head:
    name: pressure_head
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    - calibration
    unit: meter
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Water level depth relative to the borehole head.
    df_col: pressure_head
    source_unit: meter
    range: null
  longitude:
    name: longitude
    coords:
    - site_id
    unit: degree
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: GPS. Signed Earth longitude. Indicated by the probe itself.
    df_col: longitude
    source_unit: degree
    range: null
  latitude:
    name: latitude
    coords:
    - site_id
    unit: degree
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: GPS. Signed Earth latitude. Indicated by the probe itself.
    df_col: latitude
    source_unit: degree
    range: null
  Z:
    name: Z
    coords:
    - site_id
    unit: meter
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Z-coord of profile measurement site.
    df_col: Z
    source_unit: meter
    range: null
